title: Six Members Return to Incheon After iHeartRadio Las Vegas Run; Jungkook Stays Behind
detail: September 20, 2026 — RM, Jin, Suga, J-Hope, Jimin and V arrived back at Incheon International Airport in casual dress, greeting fans and sharing holiday wishes as they returned home following BTS's headline set closing night one of the 2026 iHeartRadio Music Festival at Las Vegas's T-Mobile Arena (Sept 18). Jungkook did not travel back with the group, remaining in the US for an individual schedule; he was expected to return to South Korea separately. The six members' arrival came days ahead of the Chuseok (Hangawi) holiday, which they acknowledged to fans at the airport, encouraging them to 'enjoy the holiday, eat plenty of delicious food and get some rest.' BTS's next scheduled stop is the Latin American leg of the ARIRANG World Tour, opening in Bogotá on Oct 2.

media.caption: RM, Jin, Suga, J-Hope, Jimin and V arrive at Incheon International Airport, Sept 20, 2026.
